name: Defile Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You infuse spells with corrupt fiendish power, drastically increasing their effectiveness against good creatures.

Prerequisites: Evil alignment, able to prepare or cast desecrate.

Benefit: A defiled spell is treated as a maximized spell against good creatures and creatures with the good subtype.

Against all other creatures, this feat does not modify the spell in any way (for example, a defiled lightning bolt acts as a normal lightning bolt against neutral or evil creatures).

This feat does not stack with Maximize Spell.

Level Increase: +2 (a defiled spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.)
